Ben — thanks for the ping. Quick triage notes (initial):

1) IP (Section 5) — ACME's carveout is broader than our standard inbound license. We typically accept a narrowly scoped customer data license but resist broad ownership claims over derivatives.
   - Proposed: we will provide an alternate clause that affirms customer ownership of their data and grants Redwood a limited license to operate the service and improve models on de-identified aggregates only.

2) Data residency — US-only requirement is acceptable for hosted accounts subject to infra availability. Need to confirm exact region(s) and whether Dedicated is being requested; that will affect SLA and pricing.

3) Indemnity / Liability caps — their MSA omits an explicit liability cap in Section 11. If true, that's a material commercial ask. We'll request a $XM cap tied to fees or the standard Redwood cap.

4) Compliance evidence — we can provide SOC 2 Type II redacted report. I'll attach a non-confidential version to our response.

ETA: I can produce a marked-up MSA and a short negotiation memo by end of day Fri (72 hours). If ACME insists on Sep 3 signature, we'll need to accelerate to 48 hours and prioritize the liability/IP threads.

Question for Sales: who is the billing/legal entity on the Order Form? That will determine the Exhibit mapping.
